tickets.title: US003: Safe Exchange Zone Selection
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to select a pre-approved Safe Exchange Zone from a drop-down list when scheduling a physical meetup, so that I feel secure during the transaction.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: The meetup location feature only allows selection from a hardcoded list of campus police-approved zones (e.g., "Library Lobby", "Student Union").
2. Pass/Fail: The system does not allow users to type in custom, unverified locations for the official meetup point.
